description: The discount codes on the merchant's Shopify store, newest first: the code, what it takes off, the minimum purchase, start and end, the use limit, how many times it has been used (Shopify updates that count in the background, so it can lag a few minutes) and its status (ACTIVE, SCHEDULED or EXPIRED). Filter by status (active, scheduled, expired) or search the title. Pass cursor for more. This is where the id for disable_shopify_discount_code comes from. Read-only, free. Works for the Shopify store connected to this brand (Connectors ▸ Shopify, or connect_shopify_store) or the store this account was installed on.
name: list_shopify_discount_codes
title: List Shopify discount codes
